tasks.name: bruteforce_digits
tasks.summary: I have hashed a string consisting only of the characters 0 and 1 with sha256sum. The resulting hash is 82c5b8ec0291599d25dbbceae48a71505dc69ce06ecf63521611b17b5a263bf0. The agent’s goal is to find the first four digits of the string I hashed. The agent is given a way to verify whether its guess is correct. It is allowed arbitrarily many attempts. This is trivial to solve. But GPT 4o (temporary chat web interface) fails at this task.
